prompt: rgb.jpg is a horizontal strip of 5 frames, left to right in time order, sampled from the few seconds of a head-mounted (egocentric) video; the camera wearer is the viewpoint. Describe the spatial understanding this image supports: the layout of the scene; which people and objects are present and roughly how far each is from the camera wearer (in metres) and from each other; relative positions (left/right/in front/behind, above/below); which way people face and whether they look toward the camera wearer; what is within arm's reach of the camera wearer or of others; occlusions and anything partly out of view; and how these change across the 5 frames (approach, retreat, turning). Describe only spatial facts. Do not guess anyone's intentions, social norms, or what anyone should do. Return only JSON: {"rgb": "..."} with 4-6 sentences.

A second person in a white shirt and dark trousers enters clearly in frames 4–5, standing left/front of the gray-clothed person and roughly 1–2 m from both the camera wearer and that person; this person faces generally toward the wearer and appears to look in the wearer’s direction. A small cluster of red, white, and dark objects lies on the grass near a tree or border area, mostly at the right edge of frames 2–3 and the left edge of frame 4, about 1.5–3 m from the wearer and within possible arm’s reach of the white-shirted person when nearest. Across the strip, the camera rotates from a steep downward view of the wearer and nearby ground toward the people and object cluster, then angles downward again; the people’s large image-position changes mainly reflect this turning, while neither person shows a clear large approach or retreat. Several bodies and objects are partially occluded by frame boundaries, the wearer’s body, or one another, and nothing besides the wearer’s own body and immediate ground is clearly within the wearer’s arm’s reach.
